deliverable_sha256_note: rerun this derivation; identical bytes are the pre-registered determinism check

method.advisory_arm: signed perpendicular distance from the physical joint axis to the joint-spanning line of action
method.scan_protocol: named coordinate over the SI 2 recorded jrange (deg->rad, sign preserved); all other coordinates at model-file defaults; hallux slaved 1:1 to mtp

cross_taxon_k_measured.note: same derivation run on Gorilla/Gibbon deposits against their SI rows (R_FHL mtp, R_RF knee): the ratio is constant to 4-5 digits per taxon across BOTH joints and takes a DIFFERENT value per taxon - the deposited models and the SI table disagree by a per-taxon scalar the deposit does not document

si2_comparison.k_provenance: least-squares mean of SI/derived over the five MTP-class endpoints; the MTP class is pure point geometry, so a constant ratio there is the signature of a uniform model scale between the deposited .osim and the SI computation
si2_comparison.pre_registered_tolerance: per endpoint |derived - SI| <= max(0.25 mm, 0.25 * |SI|) under exactly one unit hypothesis

unit_verdict.measured_reading: SI 2 macaque arms = deposit-geometry arms x 0.119754 (per-taxon scalar; cm reading), constant to 4+ digits on the MTP class
unit_verdict.pre_registered_requirement: exactly one of {mm, cm} inside band
